import pandas as pd, numpy as np, time, re
from scipy.stats import rankdata

t=time.time()
eff = pd.read_csv('inputs/CRISPRGeneEffect.csv', index_col=0)
print('eff read', eff.shape, time.time()-t, 'anyna', eff.isna().any().any())
t=time.time()
expr = pd.read_csv('inputs/OmicsExpressionProteinCodingGenesTPMLogp1BatchCorrected.csv', index_col=0)
print('expr read', expr.shape, time.time()-t, 'anyna', expr.isna().any().any())
# align samples
common = eff.index.intersection(expr.index)
print('common samples',len(common))
eff = eff.loc[common]; expr = expr.loc[common]
# match by exact header label
genes = eff.columns.intersection(expr.columns)
print('exact common genes',len(genes))
E = eff[genes].to_numpy(dtype=np.float64)
X = expr[genes].to_numpy(dtype=np.float64)
print(E.shape, X.shape, 'nan count',np.isnan(E).sum(),np.isnan(X).sum())
# essentiality transform
S = -E
# rank columns average ties
R = np.empty_like(S)
for j in range(S.shape[1]):
    R[:,j] = rankdata(S[:,j])
Q = np.empty_like(X)
for j in range(X.shape[1]):
    Q[:,j] = rankdata(X[:,j])
# pearson on ranks
Rc = R - R.mean(axis=0, keepdims=True)
Qc = Q - Q.mean(axis=0, keepdims=True)
rn = np.sqrt((Rc**2).sum(axis=0))
qn = np.sqrt((Qc**2).sum(axis=0))
rho = (Rc*Qc).sum(axis=0)/(rn*qn)
print('rho range',rho.min(),rho.max(),'count >=.6',int((rho>=0.6).sum()),'count <=-.6',int((rho<=-0.6).sum()))
# top/bottom
idx=np.argsort(rho)
for i in list(idx[:10])+list(idx[-10:]): print(genes[i], rho[i])
print('time total', time.time()-t)
PY"

import pandas as pd, numpy as np, time
from scipy.stats import rankdata
from math import sqrt

t=time.time()
eff=pd.read_csv('inputs/CRISPRGeneEffect.csv', index_col=0)
expr=pd.read_csv('inputs/OmicsExpressionProteinCodingGenesTPMLogp1BatchCorrected.csv', index_col=0)
common=eff.index.intersection(expr.index)
print('samples',len(common), flush=True)
eff=eff.loc[common]; expr=expr.loc[common]
genes=eff.columns.intersection(expr.columns)
print('genes',len(genes), flush=True)
E=eff[genes].to_numpy(dtype=np.float64)
X=expr[genes].to_numpy(dtype=np.float64)
mask=np.isfinite(E) & np.isfinite(X)
count=0; rhos=np.full(len(genes), np.nan); nvals=np.zeros(len(genes),dtype=int)
for j in range(len(genes)):
    m=mask[:,j]
    n=int(m.sum())
    nvals[j]=n
    if n < 2:
        continue
    s=-E[m,j]
    x=X[m,j]
    # rank average ties
    rs=rankdata(s)
    rx=rankdata(x)
    # avoid constant variable
    ss=rs.std(ddof=1); sx=rx.std(ddof=1)
    if ss==0 or sx==0:
        continue
    # pearson corr of ranks
    num=np.sum((rs-rs.mean())*(rx-rx.mean()))
    den=np.sqrt(np.sum((rs-rs.mean())**2)*np.sum((rx-rx.mean())**2))
    rho=num/den
    rhos[j]=rho
    if rho>=0.6: count+=1
print('valid n min max mean', nvals.min(), nvals.max(), nvals.mean(), flush=True)
print('rho finite',np.isfinite(rhos).sum(),'min max',np.nanmin(rhos),np.nanmax(rhos),'count>=0.6',count,'count<=-0.6',int((rhos<=-0.6).sum()), flush=True)
idx=np.argsort(rhos)
print('top positive:')
for i in idx[-20:][::-1]: print(genes[i],rhos[i],nvals[i])
print('bottom:')
for i in idx[:10]: print(genes[i],rhos[i],nvals[i])
print('total sec',time.time()-t, flush=True)

import pandas as pd, numpy as np, time, re
from collections import defaultdict
from scipy.stats import rankdata

t=time.time()
# headers
he=pd.read_csv('inputs/CRISPRGeneEffect.csv', nrows=0).columns.tolist()[1:]
hx=pd.read_csv('inputs/OmicsExpressionProteinCodingGenesTPMLogp1BatchCorrected.csv', nrows=0).columns.tolist()[1:]
def sym(x): return re.sub(r'\\s*\\(\\d+\\)\\s*"'$'"','',x)
def ent(x): return int(re.search(r'\\((\\d+)\\)\\s*"'$'"',x).group(1))
ex_by=defaultdict(list)
for x in hx: ex_by[ent(x)].append(x)
pairs=[]
for e in he:
    ei=ent(e)
    opts=ex_by.get(ei)
    if not opts: continue
    if len(opts)==1:
        xcol=opts[0]
    else:
        es=sym(e)
        matches=[x for x in opts if sym(x)==es]
        xcol=matches[0] if matches else opts[0]
    pairs.append((e,xcol,ei))
print('entrez-matched pairs',len(pairs),flush=True)
eff=pd.read_csv('inputs/CRISPRGeneEffect.csv', index_col=0)
expr=pd.read_csv('inputs/OmicsExpressionProteinCodingGenesTPMLogp1BatchCorrected.csv', index_col=0)
common=eff.index.intersection(expr.index)
eff=eff.loc[common]; expr=expr.loc[common]
E=eff[[p[0] for p in pairs]].to_numpy(dtype=np.float64)
X=expr[[p[1] for p in pairs]].to_numpy(dtype=np.float64)
mask=np.isfinite(E)&np.isfinite(X)
print(E.shape,'nan',np.isnan(E).sum(),np.isnan(X).sum(),'valid min max',mask.sum(0).min(),mask.sum(0).max(),flush=True)
count=0; rhos=np.full(len(pairs),np.nan); nvals=np.zeros(len(pairs),dtype=int)
for j in range(len(pairs)):
    m=mask[:,j]; n=int(m.sum()); nvals[j]=n
    if n<2: continue
    s=-E[m,j]; x=X[m,j]
    rs=rankdata(s); rx=rankdata(x)
    sds=rs.std(ddof=1); sdx=rx.std(ddof=1)
    if sds==0 or sdx==0: continue
    num=((rs-rs.mean())*(rx-rx.mean())).sum()
    den=np.sqrt(((rs-rs.mean())**2).sum()*((rx-rx.mean())**2).sum())
    rho=num/den; rhos[j]=rho
    if rho>=.6: count+=1
print('rho finite',np.isfinite(rhos).sum(),'min max',np.nanmin(rhos),np.nanmax(rhos),'count>=.6',count,'count<=-.6',int((rhos<=-.6).sum()),flush=True)
idx=np.argsort(rhos)
print('top 30:')
for i in idx[-30:][::-1]: print(pairs[i][0], '->', pairs[i][1], rhos[i], nvals[i])
print('bottom 10:')
for i in idx[:10]: print(pairs[i][0],'->',pairs[i][1],rhos[i],nvals[i])
print('sec',time.time()-t,flush=True)
PY"
